note: Working search query patterns discovered by the scout. WebFetch to ATS/board domains now generally works, but many company career sites are JS-rendered SPAs whose static HTML/markdown extract has no per-job detail (Ashby's jobs.ashbyhq.com HTML pages return only 'Jobs' header with no content -- ALWAYS use the api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board> JSON endpoint instead; Google careers and Meta careers (metacareers.com) are JS-rendered and unfetchable). Prefer each ATS's public JSON API over the HTML page when possible (see below). Re-check egress/rendering access each run in case it changes.

working_fetch_patterns.greenhouse: Use https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<board_token>/jobs/<job_id> (plain JSON, no auth) instead of the HTML job page when the HTML page renders a full board index instead of the single job (happens on larger boards like schonfeld, goodinside -- API also 404'd for these this run, so their board_token guesses may be wrong). Direct HTML job pages at job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>/jobs/<id> work fine for many boards (clearstreet, translucent, edo, icapitalnetwork, gemini all rendered full job detail directly this run). point72's greenhouse job-boards URL redirects (302) to careers.point72.com/ (Avature-based) -- the specific job id path did not carry over and 404'd on both point72's Avature JobDetail URL and the greenhouse API; treat as unverifiable/stale until a working point72 URL pattern is found.
working_fetch_patterns.lever: Direct job HTML at jobs.lever.co/<co>/<uuid> now returns 403 broadly (kensho, verygoodsecurity confirmed this run). The public API https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<co>?mode=json works when the company slug is exact -- confirmed working for 'verygoodsecurity' this run (returned CURRENT postings list which did NOT include the 'Sr./Staff Infrastructure Engineer' jobs that WebSearch snippets pointed to -- those appear to be stale/removed listings still indexed by search). 'kensho' and 'kensho-technologies' both 404'd on the API -- correct slug not yet found.
working_fetch_patterns.ashby: https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board_name> (case-sensitive board name) returns full JSON job list including title/location/publishedAt -- this is the ONLY reliable way to verify Ashby postings; the jobs.ashbyhq.com HTML page is pure JS and WebFetch sees just 'Jobs' with zero content, even for a specific job UUID path. Confirmed working this run for boards: Perchwell, meridianlink, radar, harvey, dualentry, ditto, unify, certifyos, junipersquare. IMPORTANT: cross-check the specific job UUID from a WebSearch snippet against the API's CURRENT listing -- several UUIDs from fresh search snippets (Perchwell SRE, Harvey SRE, DualEntry SRE, Ditto SRE, Unify SRE, Juniper Square SRE) were NOT present in the live API listing this run (stale/removed postings still indexed by search) and were dropped.
working_fetch_patterns.bloomberg: bloomberg.avature.net/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> is directly WebFetch-reachable and gives title/location/live-status reliably (no posted date shown on the page). IMPORTANT: several job ids from fresh WebSearch snippets 404'd this run (17773, 12878, 21064) or resolved to a DIFFERENT job than the snippet title claimed (21077 snippet said 'Senior SQL & Hosted Services Engineer' but the live page showed 'Senior Systems Engineer - Windows/SQL Services', ref 10052871 -- ids appear to get reassigned/reused) -- always verify the fetched title matches the search snippet title before trusting.
working_fetch_patterns.twosigma: careers.twosigma.com/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> reachable, but job IDs from search snippets can be stale/404 -- ids 10878 and 12744 have now 404'd on TWO consecutive runs despite reappearing in fresh WebSearch results each time; treat any twosigma id not already in state/two_sigma.json as needing fresh verification, don't assume search-snippet ids are live.
working_fetch_patterns.point72: job-boards.greenhouse.io/point72/jobs/<id> 302-redirects to careers.point72.com/ (loses the job-specific path); careers.point72.com/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> guessed pattern (copying bloomberg's Avature pattern) also 404'd. No working direct-verify path found yet for point72 -- would need to browse careers.point72.com search UI structure in a future run.
working_fetch_patterns.builtinnyc: www.builtinnyc.com/job/<slug>/<id> reachable; MANY listings from search snippets are dead ('this job was removed at ...') -- this run 5 of 7 fresh candidates were dead (Freddie Mac, Humana, Canoe, Fiserv, both Orion Innovation postings), only 'ProDev US' (reposted 21 days ago, still live) and previously-tracked ones were live. Always verify, don't trust snippet freshness.
working_fetch_patterns.wellfound: Individual job URLs (wellfound.com/jobs/<id>-<slug>) are directly WebFetch-reachable and give full detail including comp/remote-eligibility/posted-date when live. Many are dead (HTTP 410 Gone) -- 2 of 3 fresh candidates this run were 410 (Coder, Radimal), only Twin Health was live.
working_fetch_patterns.google_careers: www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results/<id> is JS-rendered -- WebFetch only sees nav/header, no job content. Cannot verify Google postings this way.
working_fetch_patterns.metacareers: www.metacareers.com/jobs/<id>/ is also JS-rendered -- WebFetch only sees 'Meta Careers' header, no job content or location. Cannot verify Meta postings beyond the two already-tracked baseline entries without a working access path.
working_fetch_patterns.amazon_jobs: www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/<id>/<slug> pages render fine via WebFetch/search snippets show location, but most SRE/System-Dev-Engineer postings found this run were not clearly NYC or remote-US eligible (Seattle/Arlington/Herndon-first with NY only as one of several options, or no location given) -- excluded per verify-before-trust.
